question: Does one higher-resolution, organ-balanced TRAIN sampling pipeline improve patient-balanced prostate validation Dice while retaining overall foreground accuracy?
scientific_status: Exploratory follow-up after previous test inspection. Per-run freezing does not erase cross-round adaptive bias. No new independent blind test claim.

qa.case_rule: lexicographically first TRAIN visit from first two distinct TRAIN patients; fixed before new outcomes
qa.rule: Final fixed step only, both models must pass; never extend steps or loosen gates in response to failure. A failure triggers diagnosis, not an automatic code-bug conclusion. No checkpoint from QA may be used as a candidate.

comparison.patient_split: Exact original 26/6/6 patients, 143/38/30 scans, immutable original manifest
comparison.selection_grid: new96x192x192 VAL grid only; no TEST in training, sampling, checkpoint selection or postprocessing
comparison.common_grid: original immutable64x128x128 grid and GT for ALL v1/v2 VAL/retrospective TEST comparisons
comparison.common_transform: world-coordinate affine mapping, categorical nearest-neighbour order0, v2prediction mapped to original grid
comparison.aggregation: per-class hard confusion Dice and IoU; visits within patient, then equal patients; background reported separately; both-empty excluded, false-positive absent-GT zero
comparison.boundaries: prostate symmetric surface HD95 in mm on common downsampled grid; empty surface pairs reported separately; not native-resolution accuracy
comparison.test: Once both30epochs and checkpoint selections are frozen, evaluate BOTH completed new models on ALL original30scan/6patient known TEST regardless of positive/negative VAL outcome. Re-evaluation is retrospective; no setting/epoch/model/postprocessing selection from it. Preserve prior original-test numbers.
comparison.confounds: Compare complete pipelines: resolution, organ sampling, sample exposure, checkpoint selector and patch/sliding-window context all differ. Existing 2D/3D models also differ in normalization/residual/DS/parameters; no isolated dimensionality causal claim.

adoption.basis: validation on COMMON ORIGINAL GRID; calculate separately for each same-model v2−v1 pair
adoption.additional: No automatic medical use. Report known TEST safety failures even if VAL passes; a VAL pass is only an exploratory research recommendation, not proof of generalization. No eligible model means retain originals.

stop_conditions: nonfinite loss or gradients outside normal documented AMP overflow skips
GPU walltime90min or completed30epochs each; interrupted run is not reported as completed
no extra arm, seed, augmentation, postprocessing or threshold search after scores
budget.software_fix_policy: Only a reproduced software discrepancy may justify a corrective revision, with cause, affected outputs and invalidated experiments recorded. No silent overwrite/retry.

authorization: Current human request permits independent rebuild and necessary finite training. Submission logistics handled by human; AI declaration deferred, exact assistance logged.
